doc: Cloud fraction of a latitude set of 1e-5 .. 10 degrees for the tiny, zero, negative, NaN and infinite Hadley edges of inputs.hadley_deg and the ITCZ shifts of inputs.itcz_shift_deg (0, +-5e-4, 2e-3 and 3.7 degrees): max(1e-3, hadley) is the divisor of x and of x_itcz and the scale (0.5 max(1e-3, hadley)) of the shift fade, three places a floor other than 1e-3 would show in, because the latitudes and the shifts are of the size of the floor (the 0.5 degree sweeps elsewhere never see it). NaN is the floor (Python max(1e-3, NaN) returns 1e-3, as Rust f64::max would), +inf gives x = 0 and a fade of 1. Output [i, j, k] is hadley[i], shift[j], lat[k]. Float64: rtol 1e-9. NaN and infinities may appear in the inputs (a rotation period None is stored as NaN) and in the outputs: NaN equals NaN, an infinity equals the same infinity (sign included).
